meta.policy: Official scientific codes first. Within scientific and other codes separately, prefer fewest matching species worldwide, then banding codes, then alphabetical order. All candidates are accepted. Scientific code names follow their source workbook; catalogue names remain pinned to v2025.

exceptions.spofly1: Retained v2025 species concept; v2026 reclassifies this ID as a slash (Muscicapa striata/tyrrhenica). Codes remain from the official 2025 workbook pending a taxonomy migration.
